title: The Franklinn #3- Sunset room TFI3
description:
Second Floor Bedroom with queen bed plus full bed, TV, and private/shared bath in farmhouse. Rural paradise with abundant wildlife in Big East Fork Valley.
Shared space with other guests include front and back porches with rockers, kitchen, living room,  dining room, and views of amazing forest, meadow, and creek. Adjacent to horse barn! Minutes from Lake Gratitude and hiking trails. $50 fee for hot tub cleaning and chemical setup.

host_details:
We are the proud owners of The Fork Inn in 3000 acre Big East Fork Valley. We are in a protected watershed located 19 miles west of Nashville and 10 miles north of Franklin. 

We are honored to be Stewards of Big East Fork Valley and support the nearby Center for Sustainable Stewardship. We enjoy the abundant wildlife and the many nearby creeks and hiking trails.

We look forward to your stay
